identification.description: Perennial shrub; dried root is cylindrical, tapering and yellowish-brown externally with a characteristic horse-like odour.

shlokas:
गन्धान्ता वाजिनामादिरश्वगन्धा हयाह्वया ।
वराहकर्णी वरदा बलदा कुष्ठगन्धिनी ॥१६१॥
अश्वगन्धाऽनिलश्लेष्मश्वित्रशोथक्षयापहा ।
बल्या रसायनी तिक्ता कषायोष्णाऽतिशुक्रला ॥१६२॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 161–162 in the searchable recension; edition numbering may vary.

identification.description: Perennial climbing herb with fascicled fleshy tuberous roots and slender cladodes; dried root drug consists of numerous pale cream to buff tubers.

shlokas:
शतावरी बहुसुता भीरुरिन्दीवरी वरी ।
नारायणी शतपदी शतवीर्या च पीवरी ॥१५७॥
महाशतावरी चान्या शतमूल्यूर्ध्वकण्टिका ।
सहस्रवीर्या हेतुश्च ऋष्यप्रोक्ता महोदरी ॥१५८॥
शतावरी गुरुः शीता तिक्ता स्वाद्वी रसायनी ।
मेधाऽग्निपुष्टिदा स्निग्धा नेत्र्या गुल्मातिसारजित् ।
शुक्रस्तन्यकरी बल्या वातपित्तास्रशोथजित् ॥१५९॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 157–159 in the searchable recension.

identification.description: Small creeping succulent herb of moist habitats; leaves opposite, sessile, oblong and fleshy, with small white to pale bluish axillary flowers.

shlokas:
ब्राह्मी कपोतवङ्का च सोमवल्ली सरस्वती ।
मण्डूकपर्णी माण्डूकी त्वाष्ट्री दिव्या महौषधी ॥२७९॥
ब्राह्मी हिमा सरा तिक्ता लघुर्मेध्या च शीतला ।
कषाया मधुरा स्वादुपाकाऽयुष्या रसायनी ॥२८०॥
स्वर्या स्मृतिप्रदा कुष्ठपाण्डुमेहास्रकासजित् ।
विषशोथज्वरहरी तद्वन्मण्डूकपर्णिनी ॥२८१॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 279–281 in the searchable recension.

identification.description: Prostrate creeping herb of moist habitats with long stolons and rounded to reniform palmately veined leaves on long petioles; small flowers occur near leaf bases.

shlokas:
ब्राह्मी कपोतवङ्का च सोमवल्ली सरस्वती ।
मण्डूकपर्णी माण्डूकी त्वाष्ट्री दिव्या महौषधी ॥२७९॥
ब्राह्मी हिमा सरा तिक्ता लघुर्मेध्या च शीतला ।
कषाया मधुरा स्वादुपाकाऽयुष्या रसायनी ॥२८०॥
स्वर्या स्मृतिप्रदा कुष्ठपाण्डुमेहास्रकासजित् ।
विषशोथज्वरहरी तद्वन्मण्डूकपर्णिनी ॥२८१॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verses 279–281; the text gives Mandukaparni the same properties/actions as Brahmi.

identity.name: Shankhapushpi
identity.botanical_name: Convolvulus prostratus Forssk. (syn. Convolvulus pluricaulis Choisy)

identification.description: Small prostrate or spreading herb with slender hairy stems, narrow leaves and solitary funnel-shaped white to pale flowers. Ayurvedic Shankhapushpi has historically variable botanical identification; the NCISM-associated Convolvulus identification is retained with the synonym noted.

shlokas:
शङ्खपुष्पी तु शङ्खाह्वा माङ्गल्यकुसुमापि च ।
शङ्खपुष्पी सरा मेध्या वृष्या मानसरोगहृत् ।
रसायनी कषायोष्णा स्मृतिकान्तिबलाग्निदा ।
दोषापस्मारभूताश्रीकुष्ठकृमिविषप्रणुत् ॥२२८॥
nighantu_references: Bhavaprakasha Nighantu, Guduchyadi Varga, verse 228 in the searchable recension.

metadata.note: Classical plant identity is historically variable; do not present Convolvulus as an uncontested botanical identification.
